title: OmniContext Failure Ledger
description: What went wrong, why, the test that now catches it, and the rule or playbook change that stops it recurring. Ingested by `omni graph build` as the assurance layer, so failures are linked to the code, requirement, tests and rules involved.

symptom.description: What was observed: the error text or the wrong behaviour.

root_cause.description: Why it happened. Required once a failure is fixed or mitigated.

requirement.description: Requirement being worked when it surfaced.

regression_tests.description: Test path, path::name, or qualified name.

no_test_reason.description: Required when a fixed failure has no regression test.

prevention_rules.description: Rule ids from .ai/rules, or playbook/checklist paths.
